capabilities: Open non-markdown files (.py, .js, .html, .css, .json) as editable text
Syntax-highlight code with built-in CodeMirror language support
Toggle line numbers, word wrap, and syntax highlighting
Configure which file extensions the plugin handles
extras: Open source under MIT license; files are opened as plain text and never converted to Markdown.
problem: Obsidian only edits Markdown natively, so editing scripts and config files means leaving the vault for an external editor.
summary: Code editor for non-markdown files that opens .py, .js, .html, .css, and .json files as editable text with syntax highlighting and line numbers.
